module_title: Important Days - Newly Declared National Days and Environmental Chronology
introduction: Tailored for UPSC, State PCS, and SSC CGL Tier-2, this advanced module covers the rapid wave of newly instituted national days introduced by the government alongside the highly complex chronological groupings favored in analytical questions.

core_concepts.title: Parakram Diwas / Day of Valor (January 23)
core_concepts.description: Instituted in 2021 by the Government of India to honor the birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, aiming to inspire the nation with his indomitable spirit and selfless patriotism.

core_concepts.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Divas (November 15)
core_concepts.description: Declared in 2021 to commemorate the birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda, the iconic tribal freedom fighter and leader of the Ulgulan movement.

core_concepts.title: Veer Baal Diwas (December 26)
core_concepts.description: Instituted to pay tribute to the sublime courage and martyrdom of the 'Sahibzadas'—the four sons of Guru Gobind Singh Ji—specifically Zorawar Singh and Fateh Singh, who were bricked alive by Mughals.

core_concepts.title: National Space Day (August 23)
core_concepts.description: A major recent addition. Commemorates the historic day when India's Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed its Vikram Lander on the South Pole of the Moon (at the Shiv Shakti Point) on August 23, 2023.

core_concepts.title: The Environmental '22' Trinity
core_concepts.description: Three critical ecological dates fall consecutively on the 22nd day of three consecutive months: March 22 (World Water Day), April 22 (World Earth Day), and May 22 (International Day for Biological Diversity).

important_entities.name: November 15
important_entities.significance: Birsa Munda Jayanti; also the official state formation day of Jharkhand (2000).

important_entities.name: May 22
important_entities.significance: UN sanctioned day to step up global ecological balancing.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: While August 14 is widely known as Pakistan's Independence Day, the Government of India officially declared August 14 as 'Partition Horrors Remembrance Day' (Vibhajan Vibhishika Smriti Diwas) to honor the victims of the sub-continental division. This nuance is heavily tested.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Space Day vs. Technology Day vs. Science Day
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Do not mix up these technological dates: National Science Day = Feb 28 (Raman Effect). National Technology Day = May 11 (Pokhran-II Nuclear Tests). National Space Day = Aug 23 (Chandrayaan-3 Landing).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation:
To remember the exact order of the three consecutive environmental months on the 22nd day:
22 March = W (Water Day)
22 April = E (Earth Day)
22 May = B (Biodiversity Day).

exam_strategy_tips: Recent CGL Tier-2 and State PCS papers place tremendous focus on newly declared dates. Dedicate specific focus to learning Veer Baal Diwas, National Javelin Day (August 7 - Neeraj Chopra's Olympic Gold), and National Space Day.
